cohort: The study included 123 pregnant women with gestational diabetes mellitus (GDM) between 34 and 40 weeks of gestation.
finding: Sonographic measurements of UCT, FFL, and IVS are valuable predictors of fetal macrosomia in GDM pregnancies, with UCT demonstrating the strongest correlation with birth weight and superior diagnostic accuracy.
mod_finding: The cesarean section rate was high at 64.2%.
cross-section timing: Measurements were performed between 34 and 40 weeks of gestation.
birth_weight: Macrosomia defined as birth weight >4000 g.
